newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian army destroys huge jungle drug lab.
newsitem.headline: Colombian army destroys huge jungle drug lab.

text.p: Colombian troops destroyed a drug laboratory in the jungles of southeastern Vaupes province that was capable of processing more than 2,200 pounds (1,000 kg) of cocaine a day, authorities said on Friday.

A statement from the press office of President Ernesto Samper said the sophisticated lab, owned by the Cali drug cartel and protected by Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) guerrillas, was believed to be worth about $5 million and built to house some 40 workers.
More than 1,000 pounds (470 kg) of cocaine base in various stages of processing and vast quantities of chemicals were destroyed in the army raid on the clandestine drug lab, the press statement said.
It added, however, that only two people had been caught and arrested in the jungle raid.
